summary: The previous-release outbox rollback test counts the message a release that drains its own outbox (v0.3.28 on) puts in its shard file, sealed or not, and checks that it stayed out of the graph. It had counted sealed envelopes, but a release alone seals that batch only when something asks for it, so the test failed in about half its runs against v0.3.28. Tests only.

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index or schema version change.

compatibility.detail: No product change. Against a baseline without the message outbox the test asserts what it did before; against one with it (v0.3.28) it asserts that the release drains the queued message to its shard and not to the graph.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs before the daemon serves.

recovery.detail: No product change; rolling back is unaffected.
